message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have direct access to the VirusTotal API through this interface, so I can’t retrieve live subdomain listings on your behalf. However, I can walk you through what the HTTP request would look like so you can run it yourself:

```http
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/sub-domains?limit=25&cursor=pp_next
Authorization: Bearer pp_key123
Accept: application/json
```

**What each part does**

| Parameter | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{DOMAIN}/sub-domains` | Endpoint for listing sub‑domains of a given domain (`paypal.com`). |
| `limit=25` | Ask for up to 25 results per page. |
| `cursor=pp_next` | Tell the server to start after whatever token was returned last time (“continuation cursor”). Replace `pp_next` with the actual value you received earlier. |
| `Authorization: Bearer {API_KEY}` | Your personal API key (`pp_key123`) – keep this secret! |

If you’re comfortable running curl commands, here’s a quick one-line example:

```bash
curl -H "x-apikey: pp_key123" \
     -G --data-urlencode "limit=25" \
          --data-urlencode "cursor=pp_next" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/sub-domains"
```

That will return JSON containing the list of subdomains plus pagination info (including the next cursor).

Let me know if you'd like help interpreting the response or automating subsequent requests—happy to assist!
